request: Build a small Jac web app for checking access rights. Users have roles, roles can inherit other roles, and policies allow or deny an action on a resource for a role. The app answers whether a user may do an action on a resource and lists a user's effective permissions. A deny always wins over an allow.
acceptance: If editor inherits viewer and viewer may read docs, a user with the editor role may read docs.
A deny on (editor, docs, delete) blocks delete for a user whose admin role inherits editor, even though admin has an allow on (admin, docs, delete).
Creating an inheritance cycle (a inherits b, b inherits a) is rejected.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
